scope: Reviewed offline byte-protocol simulation fixes only; no hardware or production cryptographic acceptance
fixes: Attempt/checkpoint ownership for connect, commit and rollback; late old callbacks cannot mutate new candidate
Only explicit NetworkError timeout/unavailable map to expected domain failure; internal exceptions clean own attempt and rethrow
Commit pending/committed cancellation semantics preserve truth and never claim rollback after commit
New session clears old IP proof; commit independently checks current device/request/IP/expiry and challenge
GCM fixed authTagLength16, canonical encoding and exact16-byte tag; bad packet invalidates flow and scoped attempt
regressions: Old A late success and TypeError rejection preserve B candidate and commit
Unexpected TypeError from network operation or report input is not masked, including code spoofing
Valid encrypted postcommit cancel is rejected; no cancelled state
Genuine signed old-session proof rejected by new service channel before and after a new probe
4/8/12-byte tags, 17-byte tag, padding and noncanonical discarded bits rejected; retry closed
Bad packet during pending network connection discards late candidate
previousEvidence: result.json and tests-final.txt preserved unchanged; original16 tests did not establish these boundaries
limitations: No true Android/BlueZ/USB/Wi-Fi execution or cryptographic production audit
No automatic recovery for lost commit confirmation; do not claim cancellation or blindly resend
Unknown local exceptions propagate; callers must treat outcome as an error, not a fabricated device status
Virtual checkpoint ownership/rollback still requires a real system network adapter and independent hardware verification
